$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFBO (AIP France, chart dated 2026-10-01): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.

A "fr" object holds the French column of the same chart, copied as printed and never translated: a French note sits at the index of its English twin and is left empty when the twin could not be paired with certainty; the French of the procedures and of the points' purposes is not recorded.
name: Toulouse-Blagnac

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked
source.frenchExtraction: French column of the chart text, read by script and paired with the English sentences

notes: AD prohibited to gliders.
IFR, VFR and Night VFR training flights are under restriction (see AIP France: AD 2 LFBO.21).
Taxiing prohibited except on RWY and TWY.

In case of use of a service part of handling operations nomenclature, it is mandatory to request an approved Radio contact with TOULOUSE Information compulsory 5 min prior entering TOULOUSE BLAGNAC controlled airspaces.
Routes Lavaur <---> North Toulouse tollgate <---> Toulouse Blagnac AD: MNM 3000 ft AMSL.
Gimont <---> Isle Jourdain <---> Toulouse Blagnac AD: MNM 3500 ft AMSL Carcassonne AD <---> Castelnaudary AD: MNM 3500 ft AMSL.
Flight plan filing is not compulsory if the flight remains within the lateral limits of the BLAGNAC CTR and within Toulouse TMA 4.1 and 1.1.
Traffic surveillance equipment.
AD equipped with primary and secondary radar.
Radiocommunication failure: Arrival: Squawk A 7600.
Continue to fly in visual meteorological conditions, land at the nearest suitable aerodrome, and report your arrival by the quickest means to the appropriate air traffic services unit.
Departure: Before take off: do not take off.

After take off: squawk A 7600 and continue to fly in visual meteorological conditions, land at the nearest suitable aerodrome, and report your arrival by the quickest means to the appropriate air traffic services unit.

Transit: Squawk A 7600 and continue to fly in visual meteorological conditions, land at the nearest suitable aerodrome, and report your arrival by the quickest means to the appropriate air traffic services unit.

Informations diverses / Miscellaneous Horaires sauf indication contraire / Timetables unless otherwise specified UTC HIV; HOR ETE: -1HR / UTC WIN; SUM SKED: -1HR Divers / Miscellaneous: For safety reasons, ground handling is compulsory for all commercial flights, as well as for non-based business and general aviation flights.
It is imperative to contact an airport assistant before departure from the airport of origin.
Prestataires d'assistance / Assistance providers: (voir/ see AIP FRANCE AD 2 LFBO.23).
GRF (Service d'évaluation et de report de l'état de surface de piste / Global Reporting Format ): 0400-2100, astreinte en dehors de ces horaires: 7/7. / 0400-2100, oncall outside these hours: 7/7.
Aérodrome interdit aux planeurs.
Les vols d'entraînement IFR, VFR et VFR de nuit sont soumis à restriction (voir AIP France : AD 2 LFBO.21).
Roulage interdit hors RWY et TWY.
Itinéraires Lavaur <---> péage autoroutier de Toulouse Nord <---> aérodrome de Toulouse Blagnac : MNM 3000 ft AMSL.
Gimont <---> Isle Jourdain <---> aérodrome de Toulouse Blagnac : MNM 3500 ft AMSL.
Le dépôt de plan de vol n'est pas obligatoire si le vol reste dans les limites latérales de la CTR BLAGNAC et dans les TMA 4.1 et 1.1 Toulouse.
Équipement de surveillance du trafic.
AD équipé de radars primaire et secondaire.
Panne de radiocommunication : A l'arrivée : Afficher A 7600.

Poursuivre dans les conditions météorologiques de vol à vue, atterrir sur l'aérodrome approprié le plus proche et signaler son arrivée à l'organisme des services de la circulation aérienne compétent par la voie la plus rapide possible.
Au départ : Avant le décollage : ne pas décoller.

Après décollage : afficher A 7600 et poursuivre dans les conditions météorologiques de vol à vue, atterrir sur l'aérodrome approprié le plus proche et signaler son arrivée à l'organisme des services de la circulation aérienne compétent par la voie la plus rapide possible.

Transit : Afficher A 7600 et poursuivre dans les conditions météorologiques de vol à vue, atterrir sur l'aérodrome approprié le plus proche et signaler son arrivée à l'organisme des services de la circulation aérienne compétent par la voie la plus rapide possible.
